items.why: The catalyst: three glass blocks make three bottles, and sand smelts to glass at any furnace.

aspects.why: Wool is silence a Listener can carry: every sheep in every Stage 3 world gives it, and it dissolves to Silentium.
Nether quartz, calcite in amethyst geodes and honeycomb from bee nests are ordered matter a Stage 3 Listener has already found.
Kelp and cactus grow wherever water or sand is, renewable from the first day.
